int64Value.description: A signed 64-bit integer value of the tag.

stringValue.description: A string value of the tag.

booleanValue.description: A boolean value of the tag.

timeValue.description: A time value of the tag.

Tag.description: A tag is associated with exactly one package name and user.

tags.description: All requested tags are returned, including pre-existing ones.

persona.description: Required. Persona represented by the token. Format: personas/{persona}

tags.description: Tags to be inserted or updated.

verify.description: Verify an API token by asserting the app and persona it belongs to. The verification is a protection against client-side attacks and will fail if the contents of the token don't match the provided values. A token must be verified before it can be used to manipulate user tags.

parameters.name: appPackage
parameters.description: Required. App the token belongs to. Format: apps/{package_name}

parameters.name: token
parameters.description: Required. The token to be verified. Format: tokens/{token}

createOrUpdate.description: Create or update tags for the user and app that are represented by the given token.

parameters.name: token
parameters.description: Required. Token for which the tags are being inserted or updated. Format: tokens/{token}

parameters.name: appPackage
parameters.description: Required. App whose tags are being manipulated. Format: apps/{package_name}
